goal: Production hardening pass 2: fix the valid audit findings (docker sandbox in containers, HOLO in image, aiohttp, Neo4j constraints, persistence adapters, dead code) - bridge auth and webhook findings were already fixed and are excluded as stale

tasks.task: Docker sandbox wiring in shipped containers - the single highest-value fix: add docker CLI to the Dockerfile runtime stage, mount /var/run/docker.sock into the cortex and worker containers in docker-compose.yml + docker-compose.prod.yml + docker-compose.loop.yml with an explicit opt-in profile, AND keep a deliberate fallback: if NEXUS_SANDBOX_BACKEND is unset in a container without socket access, log a LOUD warning and document in architecture-map.md that the hardened sandbox needs the socket profile
acceptance: compose files declare the socket mount under an opt-in profile
Dockerfile runtime stage installs docker CLI
env-var guard passes (any new vars documented in same diff)

tasks.task: Declare aiohttp: add to requirements.in and re-lock requirements.txt + requirements-dev.txt targeting Linux/Py3.11 via uv (the declared-runtime pattern - never hand-edit the .txt files)
acceptance: pytest tests/unit/test_declared_deps.py -q passes (registry_tool_executor.py imports are all declared)

tasks.task: Neo4j constraints and indexes: one-time Cypher migration creating a uniqueness constraint on Concept(id, tenant) plus label and tenant indexes, run idempotently on startup (IF NOT EXISTS), so concurrent MERGE writes cannot create duplicate nodes and lookups do not full-scan as the graph grows
acceptance: migration is idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS - safe on every startup)
concurrent-write duplicate prevention test demonstrates the constraint works

tasks.task: Redis/Postgres-backed adapters for goals, agents, swarms, and the autonomy audit log - matching the RedisRateLimiter pattern just done: write the adapters (ports already exist), select via NEXUS_INFRA_BACKEND, so multi-process API+Celery deployments share state and nothing vanishes on restart
acceptance: state created via one process is visible to another (shared Redis backend test)
